author: The Spiffing Brit
description:
This Youtube Video is a very special case. Because as a youtuber we can upload videos to this platform and run adverts on the videos. This is done by basically agreeing with youtube to place ads at the start, end and mid sections of a video. This system when working correctly is meant to place ads with a reasonable space between them to make sure the watch time of the video is maintained. Its a carefully balanced art to manage attention with the disruption of adverts and its why people like Mr Beast are able to make so much money by analysing behaviour patterns and attention spans to know when naturally breaks should happen in a video for adverts. Anyway this video throws all of that out the window as I use some oversights in the multitrack language audio feature of youtube to allow me to bypass some of the monetization ai checks on youtube and create an absurd video that contains 27840 adverts. That's right one advert every second of this video! 

Want to try Vidiq Here you go: https
title: This Video Has An Ad EVERY SECOND... YOUTUBE IS A PERFECTLY BALANCED WEBSITE WITH NO EXPLOITS
